action.description: what to do: create_user, set_user (enabled), delete_user, reset_2fa, set_org_admin (admin), set_network_role (role + network_id for a user or group), create_group, update_group, delete_group

user.description: the user: id, username or email (create_user: the new user's email, also the username)

group.description: the access control group: id or name (create_group: the new name)

password.description: create_user: a temporary password the user changes at first sign-in; never read back

enabled.description: set_user or create_user: true enables, false disables

admin.description: set_org_admin: true grants, false revokes; create_group: true makes an organization-admin group

network_id.description: set_network_role: the network the role is on

role.description: set_network_role: LIMITED_READ_ONLY, READ_ONLY, OPERATOR, WORKSPACE_OPERATOR, ADMIN, or none to remove

identity_provider_groups.description: create_group, update_group: the identity-provider group names that put a user in this group

network_roles.description: create_group, update_group: network id to role; update_group replaces the whole map

confirm.description: the username or group name, required for delete, 2FA reset, org-admin changes and org-admin groups

apply.description: false (default) is a dry run that writes nothing; true makes the change
